key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to poll usage APIs (10-600 seconds)

key.name: enabled-providers
key.description: List of provider IDs to display

key.name: display-mode
key.description: How to display usage in the panel: 'text' for percentage, 'bar' for progress bar, 'both' for both

key.name: show-icon
key.description: Whether to show the icon in the top bar

key.name: panel-display-source
key.description: What to show in the panel: 'worst' for highest utilization across all agents, or a specific provider ID

key.name: claude-credentials-path
key.description: Custom path to Claude credentials file. Leave empty for default (~/.claude/.credentials.json)

key.name: codex-credentials-path
key.description: Custom path to Codex auth file. Leave empty for default (~/.codex/auth.json)
